scripts.studio: npm run assets:sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:wide: npm run assets:sync && remotion render src/index.ts CLIMAX-Film-16x9 out/climax-film-16x9.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:vertical: npm run assets:sync && remotion render src/index.ts CLIMAX-Film-9x16 out/climax-film-9x16.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:square: npm run assets:sync && remotion render src/index.ts CLIMAX-Film-1x1 out/climax-film-1x1.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:portrait: npm run assets:sync && remotion render src/index.ts CLIMAX-Film-4x5 out/climax-film-4x5.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.compositions: npm run assets:sync && remotion compositions src/index.ts
